newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta stocks seen steady on Wall Street.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta stocks seen steady on Wall Street.

text.p: Jakarta stocks are seen steady on Monday following strong gains on Wall Street on Friday and announcements of strong first quarter results, brokers said.
"More foreigners are likely to re-enter the market after another closing record on Wall Street on Friday and recent announcements of strong first quarter results," one broker said.
The Dow Jones industrial average jumped 70.57 points to 7,782.04 points on Friday, its sixth consecutive closing record.
Brokers said banking stocks were likely to remain in focus following Finance Minister Mar'ie Muhammad's comment that the government planned to merge state banks into a more competitive number.
On Friday, the Jakarta composite index closed 3.4 points higher at 698.62 points.
Astra rose 50 rupiah to 7,000 rupiah, with 34,000 shares traded.
Second-liners Jababeka, Ramayana and Lippo Securities made modest gains in active trading following encouraging first quarter results, brokers said.
The market was likely to remain steady the rest of the day as foreign players were likely to stay active, brokers said.
